model_explanation: S1 says Bill is the only person Sam gave grapes to, so S2’s claim that Sam also gave Sue grapes contradicts this.
if Sue is the only person Sam gave oranges to, then Sam did not give oranges to Rob, so S2 is entailed.
S1 restricts who received grapes, not what Rob received in general; S2 about Rob receiving oranges is neither required nor ruled out by S1.
if Tom only got oranges from Sam, then Tom did not get bananas from Sam; S2 follows from S1.
S1 says Ellen is the only person Sam gave bananas to, so Sam giving Mary bananas as well contradicts S1.
if Ellen is the only person Sam gave grapes to, then Sam did not give grapes to Tom; S2 is entailed.
S1 restricts what fruit Sam gave Rob to oranges, so giving Rob apples as well would contradict S1; however, S2 speaks of an additional gift not mentioned in S1, so it is incompatible, hence:
if Tom only received apples from Sam, then he did not receive grapes from Sam; S2 is entailed.
